java: CucaDiagram.applySingleStrategy iterates each group and root's immediate Entity.leafs(), excludes every link-incident entity through isStandalone, and applies the existing three-member gate before constructing Magma.

Entity.leafs() includes only immediate children whose materialized data is not a group. Empty packages are still groups at this stage; later SVEK empty-package conversion cannot retroactively add them to Magma.

Named standalone notes are ordinary semantic leaves. Attached notes and their targets are link-incident and therefore excluded; descendants belong to their own immediate owner rather than the ancestor's Magma.
rust: single_strategy_members projects ordinary entities and unattached aliased notes into owner buckets, filters link-incident IDs, and explicitly continues over every SvekNodeEmission::EmptyPackage.
The implementation preserves empty-package SVEK emission and changes no threshold, SquareMaker branch formula, layout constant, SVG coordinate, fixture-specific predicate, or comparator input.
The fresh-label and mechanism-path scan found no production references to checker inputs, perturbation paths, or their identifiers. The implementation diff introduced no numeric constant.
